methodDetails.independence: Fresh static review of the current rewrite only. No previous audit conclusions, sibling/archived implementation or Git history consulted. methodDetails.production: Every assigned deploy Python module and install.sh read in full, including function bodies, validation, ownership, privilege transitions, process/cgroup shutdown, archive/decompression limits, immutable artifact publication, provider generations, transaction admission/recovery and workspace descriptor/Git mutations.

methodDetails.documentation: deploy/README.md and deploy/RECOVERY.md read completely, including executable backup/restore blocks and candidate archive boundaries. Historical verification descriptions were treated only as documented claims, not new runtime evidence.
